units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:3:7">Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ</cite> top <he>במקהלות כל ק׳ וק׳</he> ‘in assemblies praise God’ (<cite ref="Psalms 68:27">Ps. LXVIII, 27</cite>), in every kind of assemblies (use a different phraseology for the appeal to praise God, according to the size of the assembly).
<cite ref="Megillah 2a:12">Meg. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>י״ג זמן ק׳ וכ׳</he> the thirteenth of Adar was the date of gathering all Jews (<cite ref="Esther 9:18">Esth. IX, 18</cite>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:3">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:4">Deut. XXXIII, 4</cite>) <he>מורשה קְהִלַּת ינאי אין וכ׳</he> it is not written here, ‘an inheritance of the congregation of Yannai’ (privileged scholars), but of the congregation of Jacob (v. <cite ref="J00621"><he>יְרוּתָּא</he></cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>קְהִלּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="S00211"><he>קְהִי׳</he></cite>.
